script_text: The animal you resist may be guarding your power. Spirit Animals is collective, not a zodiac sign; I use a Scorpio baseline: Pluto rules, and water is the element. It reveals instinct, fear, desire, and transformation. On September 30, Jupiter in Cancer squares Uranus retrograde in Gemini, turning contracts, travel, and cash decisions into a 24-hour choice. Check your Gemini-Cancer houses: Gemini rising gets a 2nd-house money jolt, Virgo rising a 10th-house career jolt, and Aquarius rising a 6th-house work shake. In love, Venus in the 12th opposing Saturn in the 6th reveals a secret bond requiring boundaries, consistency, and availability. Uranus retrograde in the 8th exposes buried power, joint finances, and psychological shocks. The North Node favors discernment over control; Pluto exposes the animal fear makes you cage. Delay one financial or relationship decision for 24 hours, then verify the terms. Comment your sign for the house warning.
